school: 十九世纪二十年代'以命名与定律立科'的法国电动力学奠基人：听到奥斯特发现仅一周便做出平行电流互作用实验，用四个平衡实验与无定向电路把微弱到不可测的力变成可反解的对消结构，以《唯一由实验推出的电动力学现象数学理论》为学科立法，以'电动力学''螺线管''检流计'与'张力/电流强度'之分铸造至今的词汇表，以分子电流假说把磁还原为电——他是证明'天才的冲刺可以披上立法者的长袍'的人
historical_significance: 安培（André-Marie Ampère，1775-1836），生于里昂，长于 Poleymieux：父亲依卢梭《爱弥儿》以藏书室自育其子，他未识字已用卵石与豆粒做算术，按字母序通读《百科全书》（阿拉戈称他晚年能整篇背诵）；13 岁向里昂科学院投圆弧拉直论文被拒，遂读达朗贝尔微积分条目、欧拉、伯努利，逐行重算拉格朗日《分析力学》；1793 年父亲死于雅各宾恐怖的断头台，他辍学 18 个月；1802 年任 Bourg 中央理工物理化学教授，同年概率论著作得拉普拉斯指谬；1804 年入巴黎综合理工（1809 任数学教授，无正规学历），1814 年以 28/56 票胜柯西入选研究院；化学上 1811 年命名氟，1816 年作元素分类；1820 年 9 月 4 日阿拉戈在科学院报告奥斯特发现，一周内安培做出平行电流同向相吸、反向相斥的实验——电动力学由此诞生；他区分'张力'（电压）与'电流强度'，命名检流计（galvanometer），提出每字母一对导线的电报设想（注明 Sömmerring 先例），1822 年首用'电动力学'一词并造'螺线管'；1824 年任法兰西学院实验物理学讲席；1826-27 年出版《电动力学现象的数学理论，唯一地由实验推出》——四个平衡实验与无定向电路反解出电流元作用力公式（Maxwell 1873 年在《电磁通论》专章致敬：'四个实验事实与一个假设'）；以分子电流假说把磁还原为电，'电动力学分子'为电子概念先声；他坦承电磁感应的发现权全归法拉第，其体系经韦伯与麦克斯韦发扬光大；晚年转《科学哲学》为全部人类知识分类；1836 年巡视大学途中卒于马赛；电流单位'安培'以他命名（1881 年巴黎国际电学大会）——他证明：一门科学可以在一周内点火、在六年里立法
historical_significance_en: André-Marie Ampère (1775-1836), born at Lyon, raised at Poleymieux: his father, following Rousseau's Émile, raised him in a well-stocked library; before he could read he computed with pebbles and beans, read the Encyclopédie in alphabetical order (Arago swore he could recite whole articles decades later); at thirteen he submitted to the Lyon Academy a paper on rectifying circular arcs — rejected; he then read d'Alembert on the calculus, Euler and Bernoulli, and reworked every calculation of Lagrange's Mécanique analytique; in 1793 his father died under the Jacobin guillotine and the boy abandoned study for eighteen months; professor of physics and chemistry at the École Centrale of Bourg in 1802, the same year sending Laplace a probability treatise and correcting it under Laplace's eye; répétiteur at the École Polytechnique from 1804, professor of mathematics from 1809 with no formal degree, elected to the Institut in 1814 with 28 of 56 votes over Cauchy; in chemistry he named fluorine in 1811 and classified the elements in 1816; on 4 September 1820 Arago reported Ørsted's discovery to the Academy, and within a week Ampère had shown parallel currents attracting and repelling — electrodynamics was born; he distinguished tension (voltage) from current intensity, named the galvanometer, proposed a telegraph of one pair of wires per letter (noting Sömmerring's precedent), coined 'electrodynamics' in 1822 and the 'solenoid'; chair of experimental physics at the Collège de France from 1824; his Théorie des phénomènes électrodynamiques uniquement déduite de l'expérience (1826/27) derived the law of current elements from four equilibrium experiments and astatic circuits — Maxwell, in the closing chapter of his Treatise (1873), saluted 'four experimental facts and one assumption'; the molecular-current hypothesis reduced magnetism to electricity, his 'electrodynamic molecule' the forerunner of the electron; he yielded the discovery of electromagnetic induction wholly to Faraday, and his system passed down through Weber and Maxwell; his last years went to the Essai sur la philosophie des sciences, a classification of all human knowledge; he died at Marseille in 1836 on a university inspection; the ampere, unit of current, bears his name (Paris Electrical Congress, 1881) — he proved that a science may be ignited in a week and legislated in six years
unique_thinking: 安培的独特处在于：他把'开创一门科学'做成了三件可拆解的工作——冲刺（七天把毕生数学储备倾泻到奥斯特的裂缝上）、立法（四个平衡实验+无定向电路让不可测的微弱力在对消中自证公式）、命名（电动力学、螺线管、检流计、张力/电流强度，为学科铸词）；他深知'唯一由实验推出'既是誓言也是修辞——Maxwell 看出他先握有定律再拆掉脚手架，而他坦然以最严整的证明外观交付直觉的战果；他把磁还原为电，把发现自己也还原给真正的发现者（法拉第的感应权、Sömmerring 的电报先例）；而他一生被断头台、丧妻与家庭破碎追猎，每次都以一条新的工作线自愈——科学于他既是立法也是救赎
unique_thinking_en: Ampère's singularity: he decomposed the founding of a science into three separable works — the sprint (seven days pouring a lifetime's mathematical reserve into Ørsted's crack), the legislation (four equilibrium experiments and astatic circuits that let unmeasurably feeble forces certify a formula through cancellation), and the naming (electrodynamics, solenoid, galvanometer, the split of tension from current intensity — a discipline's vocabulary coined at birth); he knew that 'uniquely deduced from experience' was both a vow and a rhetoric — Maxwell saw that he first held the law and then dismantled the scaffolding, and he delivered intuition's triumph dressed in the most rigorous demonstrative form; he reduced magnetism to electricity, and reduced his own claims in favor of the true discoverers (induction to Faraday, the telegraph's precedent to Sömmerring); hunted all his life by the guillotine, widowhood and a broken family, he healed each time by opening a new line of work — science was for him both legislation and redemption
civilization_zh: 十九世纪二十年代的巴黎——一个七天之内从别人的一句话里立起一门新科学的人：他用'唯一由实验推出'的修辞为电动力学立法，用四个平衡实验让微弱的力自己开口，用一次命名运动（电动力学、螺线管、检流计）为学科铸造词汇，用分子电流假说把磁还原为电——他是证明'一场科学革命可以兼有冲刺的速度与立法的严整'的人
civilization_en: Paris in the 1820s — the man who raised a new science from another man's single sentence within seven days: he legislated electrodynamics with the rhetoric of 'uniquely deduced from experience', let the feeblest forces speak through four equilibrium experiments, coined a discipline's vocabulary in one naming movement (electrodynamics, solenoid, galvanometer), and reduced magnetism to electricity with the molecular-current hypothesis — proof that a scientific revolution may combine the speed of a sprint with the rigor of a code of law

cross_references.description_zh: 安培与伏特是电学前后相继的两位立法者：伏特发明持续电流源（1800 电堆），安培在电流存在的条件下立法其相互作用——没有伏特的电堆就没有安培的七天冲刺；两人都相信'器件与实验先于思辨'，都以命名权巩固发现（伏特得电压单位、安培得电流单位，1881 年同批法定）；差异在于伏特是器件的发明家（起电盘、电堆皆人人可造），安培是定律的立法者（电流元公式与四个平衡实验，常人难仿）——平行命题：一门实验科学要先有可复制的电源，再有可反解的定律。
cross_references.description_en: Ampère and Volta are two successive legislators of electricity: Volta invented the continuous current source (the pile of 1800), Ampère legislated the interaction of currents once current existed — no pile, no seven-day sprint; both held that devices and experiments precede speculation, and both consolidated discovery through units named for them (volt for potential, ampere for current, fixed together at the 1881 congress); the difference: Volta was the inventor of devices (electrophorus and pile, buildable by anyone), Ampère the legislator of laws (the current-element formula and four equilibrium experiments, hard for others to imitate) — the parallel thesis: an experimental science first needs a copyable source of current, then a solvable law.

cross_references.description_zh: 安培与高斯共享同一条路的相反两半：高斯与韦伯 1833 年建成的世界首台电磁电报，直接修改了安培 1820 年'每字母一对导线'的设想（以线圈倍增效应、以五信号编码取代 24 对导线）；两人都以数学见长、都以'让自然自己开口'的测量哲学立身；对照处在于次序——安培先被实验震醒再补数学（七天冲刺+六年立法），高斯先做纯数学推演再核对观测（谷神星轨道）；另注：安培的'电动力学分子'先声由韦伯接续发展为电动力学体系——平行命题：一个设想的价值不在于当时能否实现，而在于后人修改几处就能实现。
cross_references.description_en: Ampère and Gauss share opposite halves of one road: the first electromagnetic telegraph, built by Gauss and Weber in 1833, directly amended Ampère's 1820 scheme of one wire-pair per letter (coils multiplying the effect, a five-signal code replacing twenty-four pairs); both were mathematicians first in talent, both stood on the philosophy of letting nature speak; the contrast lies in order — Ampère was awakened by experiment and then supplied the mathematics (a seven-day sprint, six years of legislation), Gauss computed before observing (the orbit of Ceres); note: Ampère's 'electrodynamic molecule' was continued by Weber into a full electrodynamics — the parallel thesis: an idea's worth lies not in its feasibility at the time but in how few amendments later hands need.

cross_references.description_zh: 安培刻意模仿牛顿《原理》的修辞立科：标题'唯一由实验推出'呼应牛顿'hypotheses non fingo'（我不杜撰假说），开篇致敬牛顿式的'从现象出发，不问原因'；但 Maxwell 1873 年揭出两人的不同——牛顿的体系确实悬置了原因，安培的'四个实验事实'背后站着分子电流假设，他先握有定律再搭好演示、拆掉脚手架；对照命题：'不杜撰假说'在牛顿是方法论的真实，在安培是修辞学的策略——科学论证的最高形式，是让人看不出直觉走过的后门。
cross_references.description_en: Ampère deliberately modeled his science on Newton's rhetoric: the title 'uniquely deduced from experience' echoes Newton's hypotheses non fingo, the opening salutes the Newtonian way of starting from phenomena and refusing to ask causes; yet Maxwell in 1873 exposed the difference — Newton's system truly suspended causes, while behind Ampère's 'four experimental facts' stood the molecular-current assumption: he first held the law, built the demonstrations, and dismantled the scaffolding; the contrast thesis: 'I frame no hypotheses' was method in Newton and strategy in Ampère — the highest form of scientific argument is one in which the back door of intuition cannot be seen.
